tools.name: wait
tools.description:
Waits on a yielded `exec` cell and returns new output or completion.
- Use `wait` only after `exec` returns `Script running with cell ID ...`.
- `cell_id` identifies the running `exec` cell to resume.
- `yield_time_ms` controls how long to wait for more output before yielding again. Defaults to 10000 ms.
- `max_tokens` limits how much new output this wait call returns. Defaults to 10000 tokens.
- `terminate: true` stops the running cell; false or omitted waits for output.
- `wait` returns only the new output since the last yield, or the final completion or termination result for that cell.
- If the cell is still running, `wait` may yield again with the same `cell_id`.
- If the cell has already finished, `wait` returns the completed result and closes the cell.

cell_id.description: Identifier of the running exec cell.

max_tokens.description: Output token budget for this wait call. Defaults to 10000 tokens.

terminate.description: True stops the running exec cell; false or omitted waits for output.

yield_time_ms.description: Wait before yielding more output. Defaults to 10000 ms.

# Voice interaction contract

Root owns this integration contract. Voice input/output augment the existing source-grounded question flow; they do not establish building facts.

## Endpoints

- `GET /api/voice/config`: `{transcription_ready,speech_ready,transcription_model,language_codes}`. Readiness means configuration is present, not successful provider access. Voice transcription uses Gemini independently of the selected QA provider.
- `GET /api/documents/{id}/voice-vocabulary`: `{terms:[str],rooms:[{id,name,floor_label}],warnings:[str]}`. Names come from cached room elements including geometry-less IFC records, plus floor names. Native floors can come from `Storey.Name`. Drawing names are fallible recognition hints and become available after reconstruction or generated-IFC reopening; no extra extraction request is made. Custom terms work before a scene exists. No generated dimensions or assumptions enter recognition or factual answering.
- WebSocket `/api/voice/transcribe`: initial JSON `{type:"start",document_id,custom_vocabulary:[str]}`. Server deduplicates building/custom vocabulary, validates document and configuration, opens Google, and emits `{type:"ready"}`. Client then streams signed little-endian PCM16 mono at 16 kHz as binary messages. AudioWorklet converts the actual browser sample rate. Server emits `{type:"transcript",text,final:boolean}`; finals append and interim text replaces th<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="1080" />fines the shared contract. Existing upload, question, evidence, geometry and provider-selection contracts remain in force.

## Review decisions

The independent plan review found two blockers, resolved in one revision: correct finalization across speech turns, and room identity through the text-only question API. Use explicit manual activity start/end with automatic VAD disabled, plus a finalization deadline that reports incompleteness rather than success. Native IFC floor labels include `Storey.Name`; alias replacements contain floor qualification when necessary and ambiguous duplicate targets are disallowed.

## Acceptance

1. Browser microphone produces real PCM frames; partial transcription updates are replaceable, finals retained and editable; explicit Ask follows the existing evidence flow.
2. Hints include all cached room names, including geometry-less records and reopened drawing-derived labels, plus user terms. No extra label-extraction provider call; no-scene drawings explain manual hints.
3. Aliases use visible canonical replacements, Unicode boundaries and stable per-document targets; no fuzzy automatic room selection.
4. ElevenLabs reads exact displayed answer text; insufficient/unclear meaning and citations remain visible. Missing credentials, provider failure and playback blocking preserve text usability.
5. Stop/cancel/document replacement/new question/navigation release resources and ignore stale callbacks; provider faults never become evidence judgments.
6. Deterministic adapter/API/browser tests and existing regressions pass; independent changed-behavior review has no unresolved blockers. Live verification and gaps are recorded separately.

Defer always-listening conversation, automatic submission, voice model-control commands, fuzzy resolution, persistent aliases and voice cloning. MP3 is fully fetched before playback; no additional rendering, cloud hosting, auth, database, frontend build or runtime agents.
